text:
alex.csm: quick note on Suncrest onboarding — noticed embedding costs spiking during peak hours. 2x token count vs expected. Suggest proactive: 1) enable 4-bit quantization on embed models, 2) swap to r-inference-embed-small for background batching, 3) route mobile traffic to dedicated pool. Thoughts?

maria.se: +1. Embedding size looks like they're not truncating descriptions. Quant will cut mem + latency. Can run a dry quant profile: `ri quant profile --model r-embed-1b --bits 4 --dataset sample_1k.csv`

kevin.ae: FYI this account flagged as mid-renewal risk if costs keep climbing. If we can show 30-40% cost reduction, good renewal leverage.

john_suncrest: thanks for flag. We're still finishing dataset mapping this week. Any risk to accuracy with 4-bit quant? We can't regress search quality.

maria.se: accuracy drop usually <2% for embed recall on our evals if quant+per-channel calibration applied. Recommend A/B on a 10% traffic slice. Also propose routing policy: mobile -> `dedicated-low-latency` pool; desktop -> `standard-batch`.

alex.csm: propose next steps: (1) SE run quant profile & send report by Wed, (2) Prod canary (10%) for 48h, (3) enable auto-routing rule, (4) enable cost dashboard alert. I'll coordinate enablement session with Suncrest on Thur.

perf-bot: Canary created: canary-id=canary-1805001, route=mobile->dedicated-low-latency, start=2026-03-25T15:00Z

john_suncrest: Thur works. Want a short checklist for what we should monitor during canary.

maria.se: Checklist: `recall@10`, `median_latency`, `p95_latency`, `token_cost`, and `error_rate`. I'll provide a one-pager and a small script to pull metrics.

kevin.ae: capturing this as renewal playbook item. If canary shows >30% cost savings and <1.5% drop in recall@10, we'll include in renewal proposal.

alex.csm: capturing feedback: John — after canary please reply with a short postmortem (1-2 bullets) on perceived search quality. We'll use it for Optimize recommendations.

john_suncrest: will do. Thanks all.

maria.se: I'll drop the quant profile output and the routing policy snippet into the onboarding folder after the run.

alex.csm: Thanks team — I'll put meeting invite and action items in the Suncrest onboarding doc. :thumbsup:
